head: ancestor
clause_prolog: ancestor(X, Y) :- descends_from(X, Y). ancestor(X, Y) :- descends_from(X, Z), ancestor(Z, Y).
clause_souffle: ancestor(X, Y) :- descends_from(X, Y). ancestor(X, Y) :- descends_from(X, Z), ancestor(Z, Y).

head: component_of
clause_prolog: component_of(X, Y) :- part_of(X, Y). component_of(X, Y) :- part_of(X, Z), component_of(Z, Y).
clause_souffle: component_of(X, Y) :- part_of(X, Y). component_of(X, Y) :- part_of(X, Z), component_of(Z, Y).

head: contemporary
clause_prolog: contemporary(X, Y) :- time_start(X, Sx), time_end(X, Ex), time_start(Y, Sy), time_end(Y, Ey), Ex >= Sy, Ey >= Sx. contemporary(X, Y) :- contemporary_with(X, Y). contemporary(X, Y) :- contemporary_with(Y, X).
clause_souffle: contemporary(X, Y) :- time_start(X, Sx), time_end(X, Ex), time_start(Y, Sy), time_end(Y, Ey), Ex >= Sy, Ey >= Sx. contemporary(X, Y) :- contemporary_with(X, Y). contemporary(X, Y) :- contemporary_with(Y, X).

head: genetic_linguistic_correlation
clause_prolog: genetic_linguistic_correlation(X, Y) :- originates_from(X, R), spoken_in(Y, R).
clause_souffle: genetic_linguistic_correlation(X, Y) :- originates_from(X, R), spoken_in(Y, R).

head: influenced_transitively
clause_prolog: influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- derived_from(X, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- influenced_by(X, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- derived_from(X, Z), influenced_transitively(Z, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- influenced_by(X, Z), influenced_transitively(Z, Y).
clause_souffle: influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- derived_from(X, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- influenced_by(X, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- derived_from(X, Z), influenced_transitively(Z, Y). influenced_transitively(X, Y) :- influenced_by(X, Z), influenced_transitively(Z, Y).

head: instance_of
clause_prolog: instance_of(X, C) :- instance_of(X, D), subclass_of(D, C).
clause_souffle: instance_of(X, C) :- instance_of(X, D), subclass_of(D, C).

head: precedes
clause_prolog: precedes(X, Y) :- time_end(X, Ex), time_start(Y, Sy), Ex < Sy.
clause_souffle: precedes(X, Y) :- time_end(X, Ex), time_start(Y, Sy), Ex < Sy.

head: same_region

clause_souffle: same_region(X, Y) :- within_region(X, R), within_region(Y, R).

head: within_region
